test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: There is a profit of 10% when an item is sold at (5)/(6) of its actual selling price. What will be the profit percentage on the cost price when the item is sold at its actual selling price?
solution:
Given:

By selling an article at (5)/(6) of selling price, a trader incurred a profit of 10%.

Formula Used:

Profit% = (selling price - cost price)/cost price × 100

Calculation:

Let the cost price of that article be Rs. 100x

Selling price when sold at (5)/(6) of original selling price = 100x + 100x × 10%

⇒ 110x

Original selling price = 110x × (6)/(5) = 132x

Required profit % = [(132x - 100x)/100x] × 100

⇒ 32%

∴ The profit percentage on selling it at its actual selling price is 32%.
